passages.text: A song of ascents. Of David.
passages.sermon:
This is a song.
People sang this song while going up to Jerusalem.
David wrote this song.

passages.text: Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony!
passages.sermon:
This is a song of ascents.
David wrote this song.
It is good when brothers live together.
It is pleasant when brothers live together.
Brothers should live together in harmony.
passages.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד הִנֵּ֣ה מַה־ טּ֭וֹב וּמַה־ נָּעִ֑ים שֶׁ֖בֶת אַחִ֣ים גַּם־ יָֽחַד׃

passages.text: It is like fine oil on the head, running down on the beard, running down Aaron’s beard over the collar of his robes.
passages.sermon:
This psalm is a song of David.
David describes unity among brothers.
He says unity is like fine oil.
Someone pours the oil on the head.
The oil runs down onto the beard.
The oil flows down Aaron’s beard.
The oil goes over the collar of Aaron’s robes.
Aaron was the high priest of Israel.
The oil shows blessing and holiness.
passages.original: כַּשֶּׁ֤מֶן הַטּ֨וֹב׀ עַל־ הָרֹ֗אשׁ יֹרֵ֗ד עַֽל־ הַזָּקָ֥ן זְקַֽן־ אַהֲרֹ֑ן שֶׁ֝יֹּרֵ֗ד עַל־ פִּ֥י מִדּוֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion. For there the LORD has bestowed the blessing of life forevermore.
passages.sermon:
The dew of Hermon is gentle and refreshing.
This dew falls on the mountains of Zion.
The LORD gives His blessing there.
The LORD gives the blessing of life.
This life lasts forever.
passages.original: כְּטַל־ חֶרְמ֗וֹן שֶׁיֹּרֵד֮ עַל־ הַרְרֵ֪י צִ֫יּ֥וֹן כִּ֤י שָׁ֨ם׀ צִוָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אֶת־ הַבְּרָכָ֑ה חַ֝יִּ֗ים עַד־ הָעוֹלָֽם׃
